integrity: Analytic proof covers the stated universal quantifiers. The exact-arithmetic test code checks selected finite examples only. The referenced publication is a motivating source, not an assertion of authorship or prior endorsement.
limitations: Real scalar-valued Lipschitz spaces over finite positively weighted Boolean Hamming cubes; spectral support nonempty, nonconstant and invariant under a coordinate-transitive permutation group. No arbitrary nontransitive or infinite metric-space theorem, and no absolute projection constant.
title: Anisotropy-invariant Walsh projection constants in Lipschitz cubes
